title: Running an ice cream stand
target: How to keep the ice cream stand in Supermarket Simulator stocked and serving: what the game produces for you, what it asks you to do by hand, and why the stand is a station rather than a shelf.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: An ice cream stand placed in the shop
Cones and flavours bought or produced
Someone free to serve while the tills run

steps.do: Treat the stand as a station of its own rather than as a shelf, because ice cream has its own buckets, cones and interactions.
steps.because: ice cream is a system of its own, with buckets and cones as separate pieces (IceCreamBucket, IceCreamCone, IceCreamConeInteractable)

steps.do: Serve from the cone side rather than the bucket side, since the two are separate objects with their own interactions.
steps.because: the cone is its own interactable object beside the bucket (IceCreamConeInteractable, IceCreamBucket)

steps.do: Keep more than one flavour in mind when you stock up, because each flavour is data carrying its own pictures rather than a colour swap.
steps.because: flavours are data with their own graphics (IceCreamFlavourData, IceCreamFlavourGraphics)

steps.do: Leave time for serving, because scooping is an action with an animation and spoon graphics of its own rather than an instant hand-over.
steps.because: scooping has its own animation and spoon graphics (IceCreamScoopAnimation, IceCreamSpoonGraphics)

steps.do: Put the cones where the display can hold them, since cones have a display with slots of their own.
steps.because: cones have a display and display slots (IceCreamConeDisplay, IceCreamConeDisplaySlot)

steps.do: Let the stand produce the buckets instead of buying every one by hand, because buckets come from a generator.
steps.because: buckets are produced by their own generator (IceCreamBucketGenerator)

steps.do: Watch the state of what is on the stand rather than only counting cones, because a bucket carries a status and the stand keeps data of its own.
steps.because: a bucket carries a status and the stand has its own data (IceCreamStatus, iceCreamStandData)

steps.do: Check the helper record when you are unsure what the stand accepts, since the game keeps one for it the way it does for its other stations.
steps.because: the stand has a helper record of its own (IceCreamHelperSO)

commonMistakes: Stocking the stand like a shelf and expecting the game to scoop for you.
Running one flavour and treating every cone as interchangeable when the flavours carry their own look.
Serving in the middle of a rush and letting the queue at the tills grow while you scoop.
Buying buckets one at a time when the stand produces them itself.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
